div.name: success_message
div.p: The audit log hash chain is intact. No tampering detected.

div.name: error_message
div.p: Broken hash links detected in the audit trail.

record.field:
# Verify the audit chain integrity result = model.verify_chain_integrity(batch_size=1000)
# Prepare wizard values total_checked = result.get('total_checked', 0) valid_count = result.get('valid', 0) broken_records = result.get('broken', []) broken_count = len(broken_records)
# Get first broken link timestamp first_broken_timestamp = False if broken_records: first_record = model.browse(broken_records[0]['id']) if first_record: first_broken_timestamp = first_record.timestamp
# Create wizard to display results wizard = env['spsl.audit.chain.verify.wizard'].create({ 'total_checked': total_checked, 'valid_count': valid_count, 'broken_count': broken_count, 'first_broken_timestamp': first_broken_timestamp or False, 'broken_details': str(broken_records[:10]) if broken_records else '', })
# Log notification if broken links found if broken_count > 0: # Get CFO and System Administrator group cfo_group = env.ref('spsl_core.group_spsl_cfo', False) admin_group = env.ref('spsl_core.spsl_core_group_admin', False)
# Create system notification (NE-052) notification_msg = f"ALERT: Audit chain integrity check failed. {broken_count} broken record(s) detected out of {total_checked} total records. First broken link: {first_broken_timestamp}"
# Post to mail.channel or log as activity if cfo_group and cfo_group.users: for user in cfo_group.users: user.notify_warning(message=notification_msg) if admin_group and admin_group.users: for user in admin_group.users: user.notify_warning(message=notification_msg)
# Return wizard action { 'name': 'Audit Chain Verification Result', 'type': 'ir.actions.act_window', 'res_model': 'spsl.audit.chain.verify.wizard', 'res_id': wizard.id, 'view_mode': 'form', 'target': 'new', }
